target_state: Lead Detail for an active lead

acceptance_basis.directive_interpretation: Codex is the acceptance authority under the owner directive for the autonomous Forteca program. This receipt is controller acceptance, not an AICG PASS claim.

root_cause_or_implementation_gap: The active Lead Detail route still exposed the legacy CloseFlow hierarchy even though its real fetch, edit, note, task, event, offer and lead-to-case owners were present. The Forteca reference contact strip, metrics, tabbed detail body, quick-action rail and route shell were missing as a cohesive runtime composition. FRT-010 adds that composition and binds it to the existing data and mutation owners, while adding only deterministic DEV preview activity and follow-up rows when Supabase is unconfigured.

rules: Lead identity, company, contact, value, owner, status, source, dates, notes and activity are derived from the existing lead/detail/activity/work-entry owners; no ACME, Jan Kowalski or Beta Systems reference fixture is rendered.

Missing domain fields use explicit honest fallbacks such as Brak głównego kontaktu, Brak opisu potrzeb klienta or Brak zaplanowanego kroku; generated reference copy is not promoted to a domain contract.
Every visible action is connected to an existing route, link, dialog, mutation, tab state, case handoff or blocker owner; unsupported screenshot-only controls are not accepted.
The legacy detail implementation remains the behavior owner and is hidden only inside the route-scoped Lead Detail shell; no parallel persistence or action model is introduced.
Local preview rows are gated by import.meta.env.DEV && !isSupabaseConfigured(); the configured production Supabase path remains unchanged.
Responsive changes are scoped to the Lead Detail route and its registered shell/detail owners; no global chrome or unrelated route is restyled.

visible_controls_wired: Back navigation, edit, overflow menu, all five tabs, next-step open/edit, note creation, tel call, follow-up/task creation, meeting/event creation, offer action, lead-to-case handoff, blocker action and activity navigation are backed by existing runtime owners or explicit tab state. No dead control was accepted.
